reasons.code_not_in_embedding: Vector embeddings do not represent course codes: retrieves look-alike modules or programme tables instead of the named module
reasons.unfiltered_fusion: Plain RRF has no code filter: chunks that the vector list ranks moderately (other modules) outrank BM25's exact code match
reasons.bm25_vocabulary_mismatch: BM25 needs the same words: question wording differs from the regulation's wording (no stemming/synonyms), so other chunks win
reasons.fusion_dilution: Fusing BM25 into a natural-language question pushes vector's correct chunk below chunks both lists rank moderately
reasons.generic_query_list_answer: Generic question ('members of the University'); the answer chunk is a bare list with few topical words, ranked ~100th by both retrievers
reasons.code_crowding: Code appears in 15 chunks (programme tables, 'refer to department' stubs); the 3 description chunks rank 8th-12th within that set
